description: This file defines the AOP_Case_Updates class, which extends Basic and manages case update records in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for saving updates, parsing HTML descriptions, retrieving related case and contact data, and sending email notifications related to case updates.

classes.name: AOP_Case_Updates
classes.description: Represents case update records, with properties for case data, methods for saving, parsing descriptions, retrieving related entities, and sending email notifications.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specific interface, currently returns true for 'ACL'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Cleans the name, parses the description, saves the record, and triggers email notification via hook.

methods.name: parseDescription
methods.description: Fixes unclosed HTML tags in the description field.

methods.name: getContacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts linked to the case.

methods.name: getUpdateContact
methods.description: Retrieves the contact associated with this update.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user assigned to the case.

methods.name: getUpdateUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user assigned to this update.

methods.name: getEmailForUser
methods.description: Gets primary email address of the user associated with the case.

methods.name: populateTemplate
methods.description: Prepares email subject and body by parsing templates with relevant data.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends an email notification about the case update, including handling email composition and logging.
